summary.whatChanges: The RPC client's query string builder now skips `undefined` entries inside array values, so a query like `tag: ['a', undefined, 'b']` serialises as `tag=a&tag=b` instead of including the literal string `undefined`. Tests cover arrays with empty strings and all-undefined arrays.
behaviorChanges: Requests built by the client no longer include `tag=undefined` for undefined array elements; the entry is omitted.
An array whose entries are all undefined produces no query parameters at all.
Empty-string array entries are still preserved (e.g. `tag=`).
risks: Servers or tests that relied on receiving the literal string "undefined" as a query value will now see a missing entry, changing array length/indices server-side.
Only strict `undefined` is skipped; `null` array entries still serialise as the string "null".
